image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), is perched on a thin, leafless branch against a clear blue sky. The bird displays characteristic plumage with a brownish-grey head and upperparts, a bright orange-rufous breast and flanks, and a white belly. It has a short, conical bill that appears yellowish-grey with a dark tip. The wings are folded, showing dark feathers with white markings. The legs are pale and grasp the branch firmly.
